entities.name: Raphael Georges Lévy
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Raphaël-Georges Lévy was a French banker, economist and politician. He taught for many years at the École libre des sciences politiques. He had liberal economic beliefs, including support for free trade and central bank independence. He was a Senator of Seine from 1920 to 1927.

entities.name: Raphael Georges Lévy
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Raphaël-Georges Lévy was a French banker, economist and politician. He taught for many years at the École libre des sciences politiques. He had liberal economic beliefs, including support for free trade and central bank independence. He was a Senator of Seine from 1920 to 1927.
